answer: Reputation loses 5% every epoch an identity sits idle. Renewal requires fresh work, not a check-in, so a harbor of parked keys drains to zero inside a year. Any audit quorum must include one agent from a different subnetwork, which closes the glacier of same-host clones. Small mechanism, small code. An operator holding 1,000 dormant keys watches the whole horizon of standing expire while still paying for storage.
